verses.geez: መንፈሰ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ላዕሌየ፡ በእንቲአሁ፡ ዘቀብአኒ፡ አስተፍሥሖሙ፡ ለነዳያን፡ ፈነወኒ፡ ወእፈውሶሙ፡ ለቍሱላነ፡ ልብ፡ ወእስብክ፡ ግዕዛነ፡ ለፂውዋን፡ ወይርአዩ፡ ዕዉራን።
verses.translation: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he has anointed me; he has sent me to preach glad tidings to the poor, to heal the broken in heart, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and recovery of sight to the blind;

translations.lxx: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he has anointed me; he has sent me to preach glad tidings to the poor, to heal the broken in heart, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and recovery of sight to the blind;
translations.kjv: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;
translations.ron: Duhul Domnului este peste Mine, că Domnul M-a uns să binevestesc săracilor, M-a trimis să vindec pe cei cu inima zdrobită, să propovăduiesc celor robiţi slobozire şi celor prinşi în război libertate;

verses.geez: ወእስምዮ፡ ለዓመተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ኅሪተ፡ ወለዕለተ፡ ፍዳ፤ አስተፍሥሖሙ፡ ለልሕዋን።
verses.translation: to declare the acceptable year of the Lord, and the day of recompence; to comfort all that mourn;

translations.lxx: to declare the acceptable year of the Lord, and the day of recompence; to comfort all that mourn;
translations.kjv: To proclaim the acceptable year of the LORD, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all that mourn;
translations.ron: Să dau de ştire un an de milostivire al Domnului şi o zi de răzbunare a Dumnezeului nostru;

verses.geez: ወአሀቦሙ፡ ክብረ፡ ለእለ፡ ይላሕውዋ፡ ለጽዮን፡ ህየንተ፡ ሐመድ፤ ዕፍረተ፡ ትፍሥሕት፡ ለእለ፡ ይላሕው፡ ወልብሰ፡ ክብር፡ ህየንተ፡ መንፈስ፡ ትኩዝ፤ ወይሰመዩ፡ ትውልደ፡ ጻድቃን፣፡ ተክል፡ ዘእምኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለስብሐት።
verses.translation: that there should be given to them that mourn in Sion glory instead of ashes, the oil of joy to the mourners, the garment of glory for the spirit of heaviness: and they shall be called generations of righteousness, the planting of the Lord for glory.

translations.lxx: that there should be given to them that mourn in Sion glory instead of ashes, the oil of joy to the mourners, the garment of glory for the spirit of heaviness: and they shall be called generations of righteousness, the planting of the Lord for glory.
translations.kjv: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he might be glorified.
translations.ron: Să mângâi pe cei întristaţi; celor ce jelesc Sionul, să le pun pe cap cunună în loc de cenuşă, untdelemn de bucurie în loc de veşminte de doliu, slavă în loc de deznădejde. Ei vor fi numiţi: stejari ai dreptăţii, sad al Domnului spre slăvirea Lui.

verses.geez: ወየሐንጹ፡ መዝበረ፡ ለዓለም፤ ያንሥኡ፡ ዘመዝበረ፡ ቀዲሙ፡ ወይሔድሱ፡ አህጉረ፡ ዘመዝበረ፡ ለትውልደ፡ ትውልድ።
verses.translation: And they shall build the old waste places, they shall raise up those that were before made desolate, and shall renew the desert cities, even those that had been desolate for many generations.

translations.lxx: And they shall build the old waste places, they shall raise up those that were before made desolate, and shall renew the desert cities, even those that had been desolate for many generations.
translations.kjv: And they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the desolations of many generations.
translations.ron: Ei vor zidi pe vechile ruine, vor ridica dărâmăturile de altădată, vor reface cetăţile distruse, pustiite din neam în neam.

verses.geez: ወእምዝ፡ ይመጽኡ፡ ካልኣን፡ አሕዛብ፡ ወይሬዕዩ፡ አባግዒከ፣፡ ወሕዝብ፡ ነኪራን፡ ይከውኑ፡ ሎሙ፡ ሐራስያነ፡ ወዓቃብያነ፡ ወይን።
verses.translation: And strangers shall come and feed thy flocks, and aliens shall be thy ploughmen and vine-dressers.

translations.lxx: And strangers shall come and feed thy flocks, and aliens shall be thy ploughmen and vine-dressers.
translations.kjv: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, and the sons of the alien shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers.
translations.ron: Oameni de neam străin vor veni şi vă vor paşte turmele, feciori din alt neam vor fi plugarii şi vierii voştri.

verses.geez: ወአንትሙሰ፡ ትሰመዩ፡ ካህናቲሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ወአግብርተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፣፡ ወትበልዑ፡ ኃይለ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ወትትሬሰዩ፡ በብዕሎሙ።
verses.translation: But ye shall be called priests of the Lord, the ministers of God: ye shall eat the strength of nations, and shall be admired because of their wealth.

translations.lxx: But ye shall be called priests of the Lord, the ministers of God: ye shall eat the strength of nations, and shall be admired because of their wealth.
translations.kjv: But ye shall be named the Priests of the LORD: men shall call you the Ministers of our God: ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles, and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves.
translations.ron: Şi voi, voi veţi fi numiţi preoţi ai Domnului, slujitori ai Dumnezeului nostru. Bunătăţile popoarelor, voi le veţi mânca şi cu averile lor voi vă veţi mândri.

verses.geez: ወይወርሱ፡ ካልእተ፡ ምድረ፡ ወውስተ፡ ርእሶሙ፡ ትፍሥሕት፡ ዘለዓለም።
verses.translation: Thus shall they inherit the land a second time, and everlasting joy shall be upon their head.

translations.lxx: Thus shall they inherit the land a second time, and everlasting joy shall be upon their head.
translations.kjv: For your shame ye shall have double; and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess the double: everlasting joy shall be unto them.
translations.ron: Fiindcă ocara lor era îndoită, batjocură şi scuipări erau partea lor, pentru aceasta îndoit în pământul lor vor moşteni şi de slava cea de-a pururi ei se vor bucura!

verses.geez: እስመ፡ አነ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘአፈቅር፡ ጽድቀ፡ ወእጸልእ፡ ሀይደ፡ ወዓመፃ።
verses.translation: For I am the Lord who love righteousness, and hate robberies of injustice; and I will give their labour to the just, and will make an everlasting covenant with them.

translations.lxx: For I am the Lord who love righteousness, and hate robberies of injustice; and I will give their labour to the just, and will make an everlasting covenant with them.
translations.kjv: For I the LORD love judgment, I hate robbery for burnt offering; and I will direct their work in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.
translations.ron: Că Eu sunt Domnul, Care iubesc dreptatea ţi urăsc răpirile nedrepte. Eu le voi da cu credincioşie plata lor şi legământ veşnic cu ei voi încheia.

verses.geez: ወይትዐወቅ፡ ዘርኦሙ፡ በውስተ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ወትውልዶሙ፡ በማእከለ፡ አሕዛብ።
verses.translation: And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring in the midst of peoples: every one that sees them shall take notice of them, that they are a seed blessed of God;

translations.lxx: And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring in the midst of peoples: every one that sees them shall take notice of them, that they are a seed blessed of God;
translations.kjv: And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring among the people: all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they are the seed which the LORD hath blessed.
translations.ron: Cu nume mare va fi neamul lor între neamuri şi urmaşii lor printre popoare. Toţi cei ce ii vor vedea vor da mărturie că ei sunt un neam binecuvântat de Domnul.

verses.translation: and they shall greatly rejoice in the Lord. Let my soul rejoice in the Lord; for he has clothed me with the robe of salvation, and the garment of joy: he has put a mitre on me as on a bridegroom, and adorned me with ornaments as a bride.

translations.lxx: and they shall greatly rejoice in the Lord. Let my soul rejoice in the Lord; for he has clothed me with the robe of salvation, and the garment of joy: he has put a mitre on me as on a bridegroom, and adorned me with ornaments as a bride.
translations.kjv: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels.
translations.ron: Bucura-Mă-voi întru Domnul, sălta-va de veselie sufletul Meu întru Dumnezeul Meu, că M-a îmbrăcat cu haina mântuirii, cu veşmântul veseliei M-a acoperit. Ca unui mire Mi-a pus Mie cunună şi ca pe o mireasă M-a împodobit cu podoabă.

verses.geez: ወከመ፡ ፍሬ፡ ገራህት፡ ስሙር፡ ወከመ፡ ዘርአ፡ ገነት፣፡ ከማሁ፡ ያሠርቅ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ጽድቀ፡ ወኃሤት፡ በቅድመ፡ ኵሉ፡ አሕዛብ።
verses.translation: And as the earth putting forth her flowers, and as a garden its seed; so shall the Lord, even the Lord, cause righteousness to spring forth, and exultation before all nations.

translations.lxx: And as the earth putting forth her flowers, and as a garden its seed; so shall the Lord, even the Lord, cause righteousness to spring forth, and exultation before all nations.
translations.kjv: For as the earth bringeth forth her bud, and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.
translations.ron: Ca pământul care răsare ierburi, şi ca o grădină în care sămânţa încolţeşte, aşa Domnul Dumnezeu va face dreptatea să răsară, şi înaintea tuturor neamurilor preaslăvirea Sa.
